headline: Indian stocks rally as rupee hits eight-month high
summary: Indian benchmark indices surged nearly 2% on Wednesday, with the Sensex gaining 1,502 points. The rupee reached an eight-month high against the US dollar, supported by strong foreign inflows and easing crude oil prices.
why: India is currently seeing a significant rotation of foreign capital as investors move funds out of global AI-linked equities. The performance of the Sensex and the rupee are critical indicators of India's macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: Sensex
impacts.why: Heavyweight buying and foreign inflows drove the index up by nearly 2%.
